system.description:
Acquired with CR 11 or higher. Deal [3D + (Attack Power)] physical damage to the target. The target takes [Weakness (Physical Damage): 10]. Treat this effect as a Bad Status.

(CR21): Rating of the Weakness increases to 15 instead of 10.
(Fate 1): Double the strength of Weakness.

A special skill that destroys the enemy's armor and skin with a powerful blow, dealing damage and lowering defense power. Any defense is torn like paper in front of the blow.
